rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Narrow, tree-covered lane with homes hard against it and no room to pull off.
reasons: No clear room to pull off the lane
Homes hard against the lane's west side

drivers.seclusion: Bush to the east, but houses and pools back directly onto the west side for most of the stretch.
drivers.access_and_room: After the first 10 m the lane narrows to a track under canopy; no pull-off wide enough for a van.
drivers.traffic: Very little traffic; it serves a few driveways.
drivers.convention: A couple of cars park near the start by the bend, nothing further along.

flags: Mean grade 3.2%, max 10.6% (steepest in the first 30 m)
Homes close to the lane along most of its length
Low-lying, near 33 m elevation; no waterway within 177 m
sun_shade: Heavy canopy over almost the whole stretch.
cannot_judge: Surface and width under the canopy
Whether the track is public access
